list.name: motor_id
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, CONCAT(code, ' — ', name) AS __text FROM motors ORDER BY id
list.label: Motor

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.hour_bucket AS time, ms.sensor_type AS metric, h.avg_value AS value FROM readings_hourly_agg h JOIN motor_sensors ms ON ms.id = h.motor_sensor_id WHERE ms.motor_id = ${motor_id} AND h.hour_bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND h.hour_bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY h.hour_bucket

SELECT h.hour_bucket AS time, CONCAT(ms.sensor_type, ' min') AS metric, h.min_value AS value FROM readings_hourly_agg h JOIN motor_sensors ms ON ms.id = h.motor_sensor_id WHERE ms.motor_id = ${motor_id} AND h.hour_bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND h.hour_bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY h.hour_bucket

SELECT h.hour_bucket AS time, CONCAT(ms.sensor_type, ' max') AS metric, h.max_value AS value FROM readings_hourly_agg h JOIN motor_sensors ms ON ms.id = h.motor_sensor_id WHERE ms.motor_id = ${motor_id} AND h.hour_bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND h.hour_bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY h.hour_bucket

SELECT h.hour_bucket AS time, ms.sensor_type AS metric, h.anomaly_count AS value FROM readings_hourly_agg h JOIN motor_sensors ms ON ms.id = h.motor_sensor_id WHERE ms.motor_id = ${motor_id} AND h.hour_bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND h.hour_bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY h.hour_bucket

panels.title: Recent Raw Readings (last 3 days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.recorded_at AS time, ms.sensor_type AS metric, r.value FROM readings r JOIN motor_sensors ms ON ms.id = r.motor_sensor_id WHERE ms.motor_id = ${motor_id} AND r.recorded_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND r.recorded_at >= $__timeFrom() AND r.recorded_at <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY r.recorded_at

panels.description: Queries the raw readings table (3-day retention). For longer history, use the hourly aggregate panels above.
